name: WorkflowEngine.NET
description: Workflow Engine by Optimajet, the embeddable workflow engine for .NET and C#. Approvals, state machines and long-running processes with a visual Workflow Designer, BPMN import and six databases.

paragraphs: Workflow Engine by Optimajet is an embeddable workflow engine for .NET and C# applications. It adds approvals, state machines and long-running business processes to your own app, with a visual Workflow Designer that developers and business users open in the browser. It installs from NuGet as WorkflowEngine.NETCore-Core, runs inside your process with no separate server, and stores process state in SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB or SQLite. Optimajet has developed it since 2014, and its official site is workflowengine.io.

Start with Workflow Engine Free (formerly Community Edition). It costs nothing, needs no license key and no sales call, and includes the full Workflow Designer. Use it for personal projects and for internal commercial use, with attribution, up to 10 workflow definitions (schemes) and 4 execution threads. When you need more, buy a paid edition and register its license key in the same app: your schemes and code keep working. The Team and Complete editions have public prices, no royalties and no per-execution fees.
Get Workflow Engine Free · Quick start · Website · Documentation · Workflow Designer demo · Compare products · Pricing
features: Workflow Designer: an HTML5 editor you embed in your app, for developers and for business users
Workflow as Code: build a scheme in C# with ProcessDefinitionBuilder and compile-time checks, as in the quick start
BPMN Support: import supported BPMN diagrams as native schemes and review conversion issues before running them
Workflow Templates: reuse one scheme inside others
Workflow Forms: attach forms to activities and run the connected commands; included in Workflow Engine NEO, an add-on for the Complete edition
